column3: The time we have been waiting for has finally come! All who oppose the Horde must be taught a harsh lesson. Burn Hillsbrad to the ground - leave no one alive!

The Fall of Hillsbrad

The Gilneans were foolish enough to test our Armada on the open waters, now they flee like the cowards they are. Show them the true price of their arrogance, and send them all to the bottom of the sea!
column4: Ґілнеасці виявилися досить недалекоглядними, бо вирішили випробувати на міць нашу армаду у відкритих водах, а тепер тікають як боягузи. Покажіть їм, що буває з тими хто поводитися так самовпевнено, і відправте їх усіх на дно!

Refineries.
Oil refining is an important part of naval expansion. Building refineries enables you to extract even more oil. It is recommended that you build refineries in close proximity to oil rigs, as this enables your tankers to deliver the resource as a faster rate.
